lines.text: Meet the agent. Open a chat and ask anything about your marketing — say, where did our organic revenue come from last month? Then send.
It doesn't guess. It walks your real accounts — Search Console, Analytics, your store — and comes back with your actual numbers, on a chart.
[warm] But the agent isn't a page. It lives in the sidebar, on every screen. Take the Brand page — and open the agent right here.
Ask it to rewrite your tone of voice — warmer, more handmade. And watch the page: the text changes in front of you.
Same with your content. Head into SEO, open the Content Plan, and pick any draft.
Scroll to the intro, and just say: shorten it. The agent edits the draft right on the page.
[warm] It creates, too. Back in Ad Creatives, ask for an autumn ad — and it lands straight in your library.
Want any of this on autopilot? Say: do this every Monday. It becomes a scheduled task — recap in your inbox, every week.
[warm] So that's the agent. Everything you've connected, it sees. Everything you see, it can change. Just ask.
